consequence.statement: New optional dnsPolicy and dnsConfig settings are available in the template sections; existing configurations are unaffected unless an operator chooses to use them.

assertion.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 adds support for configuring dnsPolicy and dnsConfig through the template sections; this is a new opt-in capability.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The change covers two fields (dnsPolicy, dnsConfig) across the template sections of several components and custom resource kinds, so it has no single crd-field identity, and the text names no specific kind or path.; applicability: This is a purely additive, opt-in capability. The evidence describes no existing environment state in which something happens.
